_comment: Placeholder list of regulatory guidance index pages for BioLitAgent.
Each source is polled each run; changes trigger LLM extraction and a
id             – stable unique key used in regulatory_state.json
agency         – FDA | EMA | ICH (written into output records)
requires_js    – true if the page is a JS SPA (needs Playwright full render)
wait_selector  – CSS selector to wait for before scraping (null = DOMContentLoaded)
enabled        – set false to skip without deleting the entry

sources.name: FDA CBER — Recently Issued Guidance Documents
sources.notes: Short-lived 'recently issued' listing — ideal for change detection. Complement with the full biologics-guidances index for historical coverage.

sources.name: FDA CBER — Biologics Guidances (full index)
sources.notes: DISABLED — this URL returned HTTP 404 when last verified (2026-09-25). The FDA appears to have reorganised the CBER guidance index. The 'fda-cber-recently-issued' source above points to a confirmed working sub-page. Re-enable this entry only after verifying the correct replacement URL at https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/biologics-guidances or equivalent.

sources.name: FDA — Search FDA Guidance Documents (all centres)
sources.notes: Disabled by default — this page is very large and JS-heavy. Enable only if centre-specific pages miss documents. Consider filtering by product type query parameter.

sources.name: EMA — Scientific Guidelines (human medicines)
sources.notes: Drupal 11 server-rendered index page. Contains category links leading to topic sub-pages (e.g., Biological guidelines). Biological guideline documents are not embedded directly on this page.

sources.name: EMA — Scientific Guidelines: Biologicals
sources.notes: DISABLED — Verified candidate URL resolves with HTTP 200 (updated from legacy /research-development/ path to /research-and-development/scientific-guidelines/biological-guidelines). Biological guidance documents live on this dedicated sub-page rather than being merged inline into ema-scientific-guidelines. Kept disabled to maintain active source count at 4; enable when dedicated biological monitoring is required.

sources.name: ICH — Quality Guidelines (Q series)
sources.notes: Angular SPA — requires full JS rendering via Playwright. Q series covers pharmaceutical quality (Q6B for biotech, Q11 for drug substance development, etc.).

sources.name: ICH — Safety Guidelines (S series)
sources.notes: Angular SPA. S series covers preclinical / non-clinical safety testing for biologics.

sources.name: ICH — Efficacy Guidelines (E series)
sources.notes: Disabled by default — less directly relevant to process/manufacturing focus. Enable for clinical development monitoring.
